<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def grid_of(fr):
    g = {}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        b = n['boundary']
        r0 = min(p[0] for p in b); c0 = min(p[1] for p in b)
        if n['pixels']==4: g[(r0,c0)] = n['color']
    return g
before = grid_of(current_frame)
res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':35,'col':48}])
after = grid_of(current_frame)
diff = [(k, before.get(k), after.get(k)) for k in sorted(set(before)|set(after)) if before.get(k)!=after.get(k)]
print("probe N(34,47):", {k:res.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','level_completed')}, "diffs:", diff)
if (35,23) in after and after[(35,23)]=='Y':
    # confirmed: row 35 moves right. Execute remaining 4 right + 3 outer-loop clockwise
    res2 = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':35,'col':48}]*4 + [{'action':'MOUSE','row':17,'col':39}]*3)
    final = grid_of(current_frame)
    print("batch done:", {k:res2.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','level_completed','done','reward','score')})
    print("Y positions:", [k for k,v in final.items() if v=='Y'])
    print("ring cells:", {c: final.get(c) for c in [(26,35),(35,35)]})
else:
    print("UNEXPECTED direction; diffs above")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
